--- diagram: frontend-sequence-scene uml-type: Sequence Diagram (Frontend — Scene/Page Transition) source: docs/FRONTEND.md §4.2 Navigation Map, §5.1 Component Hierarchy generated: 2026-05-08 --- # Frontend Sequence Diagram — Scene 切換流程（P01 → P02 → P03） > 場景：使用者在 P01 Token 列表點「建立 Token」→ 提交 P02 Modal → redirect P03 一次性揭示頁。 > 涵蓋資源載入、Alpine 元件初始化、TempData 傳遞、CSP nonce 注入。 ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant U as User (Browser) participant Cache as Browser Cache participant Razor as Razor Page Server participant TempData as TempDataProvider participant Alpine as Alpine.js Runtime participant CDN as jsDelivr CDN (Alpine SRI) participant API as POST /api/v1/me/tokens Note over U,Razor: Scene 1: P01 Token 列表初始載入 U->>Razor: GET /ApiTokens Razor->>Razor: PageModel.OnGetAsync()
查詢 ITokenAppService.ListMyTokens(userId, status, page) Razor-->>U: 200 HTML
Content-Security-Policy: nonce-xyz
Set-Cookie: AspNetCore.Antiforgery.cookies U->>Cache: cache HTML (no-store)
preload alpine.js + tailwind U->>CDN: GET alpine.min.js (SRI: sha384-...) CDN-->>U: 200 + integrity verified U->>Alpine: Alpine.start() Alpine->>Alpine: x-data="tokenCreateModal()" init
{ description: '', isSubmitting: false, error: null } Alpine->>Alpine: x-data="revokeConfirmModal()" init
{ tokenId: null, isOpen: false, isLoading: false } Alpine-->>U: 元件就緒（≈ 200ms） Note over U,API: Scene 2: P02 Create Modal 開啟 + 提交 U->>Alpine: 點擊 [+ 建立 Token] Alpine->>Alpine: tokenCreateModal.open()
focus 描述輸入框 U->>Alpine: 輸入 "N8N 銷售報表" + 點擊 [建立] Alpine->>Alpine: validate description (1..100 chars) Alpine->>Alpine: isSubmitting = true（disable buttons） Alpine->>API: POST /api/v1/me/tokens
Headers: X-CSRF-Token, Idempotency-Key (uuidv4)
Body: { description: "N8N 銷售報表" } alt 201 Created API-->>Alpine: 201 { tokenId, tokenPrefix, rawToken, createdAt } Alpine->>TempData: writeTempData("RawToken", rawToken)
writeTempData("TokenPrefix", tokenPrefix) Alpine-->>U: window.location.href = "/ApiTokens/Created" else 422 描述空 / >100 字 API-->>Alpine: 422 { error: "DESCRIPTION_INVALID", details } Alpine->>Alpine: error = "描述需 1..100 字元"
isSubmitting = false
shake animation else 429 達 50 上限 API-->>Alpine: 429 { error: "TOKEN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED", current: 50 } Alpine->>Alpine: error = "已達 Token 上限（50 個），請先撤銷舊 Token" end Note over U,Razor: Scene 3: P03 一次性揭示頁 U->>Razor: GET /ApiTokens/Created (redirect target) Razor->>TempData: readTempData("RawToken") TempData-->>Razor: rawToken (one-time consume) Razor->>TempData: readTempData("TokenPrefix") TempData-->>Razor: tokenPrefix Razor->>Razor: PageModel.RawToken = rawToken
PageModel.TokenPrefix = tokenPrefix alt TempData 有效 Razor-->>U: 200 HTML (P03 cshtml)
Cache-Control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate U->>Alpine: Alpine.start() init copyButton(rawToken) U->>U: 看到一次性 token，必須勾選確認 + 複製 else TempData 缺失（重新整理 P03） Razor-->>U: 302 Found → /ApiTokens
FRONTEND §4.2 navigation rule end Note over U,Razor: Scene 4: 離開 P03 → 返回 P01 U->>Alpine: 勾選「我已複製」+ 點擊 [關閉] Alpine->>Alpine: confirmCheckbox.checked = true → close button enabled Alpine-->>U: window.location.href = "/ApiTokens" U->>Razor: GET /ApiTokens (refresh listing) Razor-->>U: 200 HTML（含新建立的 Token row） ``` ## 資源載入策略（FRONTEND §11 Performance Budget） | 資源 | 載入方式 | 大小 | |------|---------|------| | Alpine.js 3.14.9 | CDN + SRI hash | ~15KB gzipped | | Tailwind CSS（編譯後） | `wwwroot/css/site.css` | ~30KB gzipped | | Heroicons SVG | inline | ~2KB per icon | | Razor HTML | server-rendered | < 80KB per page | ## TempData 流程 | 步驟 | 機制 | |------|------| | 寫入（P02 → redirect） | `[TempData] public string RawToken { get; set; }` server-side（POST handler 寫，redirect 後保留一次） | | 讀取（P03 OnGet） | TempData 自動標記 consumed，下次 request 即清空 | | 重新整理 P03 | TempData 已 consumed → null → middleware 偵測後 redirect 回 P01 | ## 安全規則 - P03 必設 `Cache-Control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate`（API.md §2.2） - RawToken 不寫 localStorage / sessionStorage / Cookie；僅 server TempData 一次性傳遞 - CSP nonce 注入避免 inline script XSS
expected_html:
sequenceDiagram
    participant U as User (Browser)
    participant Cache as Browser Cache
    participant Razor as Razor Page Server
    participant TempData as TempDataProvider
    participant Alpine as Alpine.js Runtime
    participant CDN as jsDelivr CDN (Alpine SRI)
    participant API as POST /api/v1/me/tokens

    Note over U,Razor: Scene 1: P01 Token 列表初始載入
    U->>Razor: GET /ApiTokens
    Razor->>Razor: PageModel.OnGetAsync()<br/>查詢 ITokenAppService.ListMyTokens(userId, status, page)
    Razor-->>U: 200 HTML<br/>Content-Security-Policy: nonce-xyz<br/>Set-Cookie: AspNetCore.Antiforgery.cookies
    U->>Cache: cache HTML (no-store)<br/>preload alpine.js + tailwind
    U->>CDN: GET alpine.min.js (SRI: sha384-...)
    CDN-->>U: 200 + integrity verified
    U->>Alpine: Alpine.start()
    Alpine->>Alpine: x-data="tokenCreateModal()" init<br/>{ description: '', isSubmitting: false, error: null }
    Alpine->>Alpine: x-data="revokeConfirmModal()" init<br/>{ tokenId: null, isOpen: false, isLoading: false }
    Alpine-->>U: 元件就緒（≈ 200ms）

    Note over U,API: Scene 2: P02 Create Modal 開啟 + 提交
    U->>Alpine: 點擊 [+ 建立 Token]
    Alpine->>Alpine: tokenCreateModal.open()<br/>focus 描述輸入框
    U->>Alpine: 輸入 "N8N 銷售報表" + 點擊 [建立]
    Alpine->>Alpine: validate description (1..100 chars)
    Alpine->>Alpine: isSubmitting = true（disable buttons）
    Alpine->>API: POST /api/v1/me/tokens<br/>Headers: X-CSRF-Token, Idempotency-Key (uuidv4)<br/>Body: { description: "N8N 銷售報表" }

    alt 201 Created
        API-->>Alpine: 201 { tokenId, tokenPrefix, rawToken, createdAt }
        Alpine->>TempData: writeTempData("RawToken", rawToken)<br/>writeTempData("TokenPrefix", tokenPrefix)
        Alpine-->>U: window.location.href = "/ApiTokens/Created"
    else 422 描述空 / >100 字
        API-->>Alpine: 422 { error: "DESCRIPTION_INVALID", details }
        Alpine->>Alpine: error = "描述需 1..100 字元"<br/>isSubmitting = false<br/>shake animation
    else 429 達 50 上限
        API-->>Alpine: 429 { error: "TOKEN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED", current: 50 }
        Alpine->>Alpine: error = "已達 Token 上限（50 個），請先撤銷舊 Token"
    end

    Note over U,Razor: Scene 3: P03 一次性揭示頁
    U->>Razor: GET /ApiTokens/Created (redirect target)
    Razor->>TempData: readTempData("RawToken")
    TempData-->>Razor: rawToken (one-time consume)
    Razor->>TempData: readTempData("TokenPrefix")
    TempData-->>Razor: tokenPrefix
    Razor->>Razor: PageModel.RawToken = rawToken<br/>PageModel.TokenPrefix = tokenPrefix
    alt TempData 有效
        Razor-->>U: 200 HTML (P03 cshtml)<br/>Cache-Control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate
        U->>Alpine: Alpine.start() init copyButton(rawToken)
        U->>U: 看到一次性 token，必須勾選確認 + 複製
    else TempData 缺失（重新整理 P03）
        Razor-->>U: 302 Found → /ApiTokens<br/>FRONTEND §4.2 navigation rule
    end

    Note over U,Razor: Scene 4: 離開 P03 → 返回 P01
    U->>Alpine: 勾選「我已複製」+ 點擊 [關閉]
    Alpine->>Alpine: confirmCheckbox.checked = true → close button enabled
    Alpine-->>U: window.location.href = "/ApiTokens"
    U->>Razor: GET /ApiTokens (refresh listing)
    Razor-->>U: 200 HTML（含新建立的 Token row）
